title: 2023 Panini Select #22 Myles Murphy Black & Green Prizm Die-Cut Rookie Bengals
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Panini Select sports trading card featuring Myles Murphy of the Cincinnati Bengals. It is a Rookie card from the Black and Green Prizms Die Cuts insert set, with a Concourse Black and Green Prizm Die-Cut design. The card is made of 35 Pt. card stock and is an original release by Panini. It is a Die-Cut parallel variety card in English, manufactured in the United States for the NFL Super Bowl event.
